Travel time from each small area to each practice

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_travel.Rd

Motorised travel time in whole minutes from each small area's population-weighted centroid to each practice's main site.

Usage

cornwall_travel

Format

An integer matrix with 337 rows (cornwall_lsoa$lsoa) and 55 columns (cornwall_gp$practice). Values are rounded to whole minutes with a 1-minute floor, which covers same-cell and adjacent-cell pairs; about half of in-area registrations have a value of 1. NA marks pairs with no road connection: the Isles of Scilly area and practice are reachable only from each other.

Source

Derived from the Malaria Atlas Project motorised friction surface (Weiss et al. 2020), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution, and the locations in cornwall_gp and cornwall_lsoa. See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

Details

Times are least-cost paths through the Malaria Atlas Project 2019 motorised friction surface (about 1 km cells), computed with terra::costDist() over land in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly; the sea and the Devon border act as barriers. Times are measured to the edge of the practice's cell, so they run slightly (under a minute) shorter than cell-centre to cell-centre. The road network dates from about 2019, traffic is not modelled, and 1 km cells are coarse in towns, where several practices can share a cell. Values are taken from cornwall_gp_travel.tif at each centroid's cell.

References

Weiss, D. J., Nelson, A., Vargas-Ruiz, C. A., et al. (2020). Global maps of travel time to healthcare facilities. Nature Medicine, 26, 1835-1838. doi:10.1038/s41591-020-1059-1

See also

cornwall_gp_travel, cornwall_flows

Examples

cornwall_travel[1:3, 1:4]
#>           L82001 L82003 L82004 L82006
#> E01018750     67     49     46     78
#> E01018751     67     49     46     78
#> E01018752     68     49     47     79
# Minutes to the nearest practice, mainland areas
summary(apply(cornwall_travel[!cornwall_lsoa$scilly, ], 1, min, na.rm = TRUE))
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>   1.000   1.000   1.000   2.568   3.000  13.000
